1.

Thou gentle Lamb of God, Thou precious Lamb, Who camest down to earth, And tookest upon Thee our sin and shame, And didst endure anguish and distress;

C.

Thou didst step forth in our place, And didst die on Golgotha, Thou didst die for us, O holy Lamb of God, Praise Thee! Hallelujah!

2.

Thou wast wounded and smitten sore, That Thou mightest set us free From sin’s guilt and the grievous penalty, And Satan’s tyranny.

3.

We walk by faith in Jesus Christ, Toward heaven we go, To receive at last our inheritance In the city of the living God.
